notes: Live-exact 4h bars (sr.resample_closed_4h), daily 2y / weekly 5y via live download_confirmation_data + timeframe_trend_confirmed; 15m confirmation excluded (no 2y intraday history); premarket excluded (live-only). Next-bar-open entry. Stop wins same-bar ties. R net of costs; expectancy judged on net R. Portfolio: event-driven, 1% marked-equity risk/trade, max 5 concurrent, max 5% open risk. Configs with <10 trades flagged ineligible.

conclusion.1_structural_edge_credible: Yes. Net +0.221R/trade over 73 trades (U15, t=1.24, suggestive) and +0.335R over 305 trades (UX 51-symbol, t=3.35, significant). ~380 trades combined, profit factor ~1.45, edge survives 25bps costs (+0.14 to +0.21R).
conclusion.2_filters_improving_expectancy: ADX>=20 is the only single gate that clearly improves U15 (0.221R -> 0.291R, 63 trades). RR>=2 is neutral-ish (+0.005R). On the 51-symbol universe the full ex-15m stack (13 trades, +0.569R) and full-minus-market (44 trades, +0.383R) beat baseline, so the stack has value ex-market-gate.
conclusion.3_filters_cutting_trades_without_helping: market CONFIRM (73->38 trades, 0.221R -> 0.012R), MTF alignment (73->28, -> 0.151R), RVOL>=0.80 (73->45, -> 0.192R). All three cost more in frequency than they return in expectancy on U15.
conclusion.4_market_confirm_hard: No. It halves trade count and drives expectancy to ~zero as a single gate; removing it from the full stack gives the best-balanced UX config (44 trades, +0.383R, 5.5% DD). Demote to soft context or drop.
conclusion.5_rvol_hard: Neutral evidence (slightly negative single-gate on U15; full-minus-rvol ineligible n=6). Keep as soft preference, not a hard gate, pending more data.
conclusion.6_mtf_hard: Mixed: hurts as single gate on U15 but belongs to the full stack that works on UX. Keep for now; retest leave-one-out on the wide universe before deciding.
conclusion.7_rr2_hard: Keep. Neutral on expectancy (+0.226R vs 0.221R) and it enforces the payoff structure the edge depends on (avg win ~2.4x avg loss).
conclusion.8_scanner_exit_hard: No. Exit A 0.166R < B 0.210R < C(protect1R) 0.221R on S0/U15. Ignoring 225 scanner EXITs gains +0.45R per trade (+101R total): 56 would-be TP1s outweigh 139 would-be stops. Replace hard EXIT with protect1R (exit only after +1R MFE).
conclusion.9_best_balance: U15: structural+ADX>=20 with protect1R exit (63 trades, +0.291R net, PF 1.60, 10.8% max DD, +20.2% total, 43% market exposure). UX: full-minus-market with protect1R (44 trades, +0.383R, 5.5% DD, +17.3%). Most consistent across both universes: structural+ADX>=20 + protect1R.
10_v54_candidates: Drop market_gate==CONFIRM as a hard BUY NOW requirement (strongest evidence).
Replace hard scanner-EXIT with protect1R: honor EXIT only after the trade first reached +1R (strong evidence, +0.45R per EXIT trade).
Keep ADX>=20 as a hard gate (improves U15, neutral on UX).
Keep RR>=2.0 hard (payoff structure); keep RVOL>=0.80 and MTF as soft/keep-hard pending wide-universe leave-one-out.

Fresh BUY state is vestigial: 91 U15 crosses -> 91 state-BUY -> 5 entry-YES -> 0 structural (86/91 price outside buy zone at the cross). Either redesign the fresh-BUY entry funnel or remove the state; do not expect BUY NOW signals from it.
Re-run this exact backtest after any rule change before going live.
conclusion.caveats: 2y window is all bull-market; 1h history caps at 2y so no bear-market validation. 15m confirmation and premarket still excluded. 2026 YTD subperiod was negative (-0.08 to -0.13R). Do not tune per-ticker (samples 2-10/trade per name).
